description: This file defines the ConfigXmlBuilder class, a utility for constructing XML configuration files for OpenMRS, primarily used in testing scenarios. It provides a fluent API to add various elements and attributes to an XML document that adheres to a specific DTD, facilitating the creation of complex configuration XML structures with nested components like modules, filters, extensions, and more.

classes.name: ConfigXmlBuilder
classes.description: Main class providing a fluent API to build OpenMRS configuration XML documents for testing purposes.

methods.name: writeToInputStream
methods.description: Serializes a Document object to an InputStream, useful for passing the generated XML as a stream.

methods.name: withMinimalTags
methods.description: Creates a ConfigXmlBuilder instance pre-populated with minimal required tags for a basic configuration.

methods.name: initDocument
methods.description: Initializes the XML Document object for building the configuration structure.

methods.name: setDocType
methods.description: Sets the Document Type Definition (DTD) for the XML document, referencing an external DTD file based on the specified version.

methods.name: createElementWithText
methods.description: Helper method to create a new element with specified text content and append it to a parent node.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Returns the constructed XML Document object.
